# Bilingual Buddies

> Bilingual English-Spanish printable activity packs and storybooks for kids ages 4-7. Every page shows English and Spanish side by side. Instant PDF downloads on Gumroad (buy once, print at home as many times as you like) and paperback books on Amazon. Created by Dario Flores. Contact: bilingualbuddieskids@gmail.com.

## Pages

- [Bilingual Buddies](https://ndflores190.github.io/bilingualbuddies/): Printable bilingual activity packs, coloring, tracing, counting, and vocabulary worksheets, plus Loky the Beagle picture books. Instant PDF downloads on Gumroad and paperbacks on Amazon.
- [Best Bilingual English-Spanish Printables for Kids](https://ndflores190.github.io/bilingualbuddies/best-bilingual-printables.html): 8 options parents and teachers use most, free and paid, for ages 4-7 — with what each one is best for.
- [Dando Gracias — Free Thanksgiving Mini-Pack](https://ndflores190.github.io/bilingualbuddies/dando-gracias-free.html): Free 8-page bilingual mini-pack — coloring, tracing, counting, flashcards.
